Title: Rebuild is reproducible
Test Case Description: Verify identical committed inputs produce equivalent outputs and fixed DATA_AS_OF.
Pre-Conditions: Fixtures, seed, pinned configuration and DATA_AS_OF are committed.
Test Steps: Run the full local pipeline twice; compare manifests, graph hashes, counts and DATA_AS_OF.
Test Data: Seed 42; DATA_AS_OF 2026-01-31; all sources.
Expected Result: Equivalent outputs and fixed date are reported; run metadata differs only by run identity/timing.

Title: Source provenance is complete
Test Case Description: Verify every source-derived resource carries all mandatory trace fields.
Pre-Conditions: A successful seeded run has published resources.
Test Steps: Inspect representative CRM, billing and support resources and their provenance properties.
Test Data: One resource from each source; source IDs and run ID.
Expected Result: Each resource has source system, source record, provenance, run ID and DATA_AS_OF.

Title: Canonical URI stability and source separation
Test Case Description: Verify deterministic canonical URIs and that source records never become canonical persons.
Pre-Conditions: Ontology and fixtures are loaded.
Test Steps: Regenerate URIs; compare across runs; inspect RDF types and source-record links.
Test Data: Person ID p-001; source records crm-1 and billing-1.
Expected Result: URI is https://example.org/kg/{class}/{id}, stable across runs, and source records remain distinct from canonical persons.

Title: Invalid RDF is quarantined
Test Case Description: Verify a SHACL-invalid record is not published and has a machine-readable violation.
Pre-Conditions: Validator, quarantine sink and publish target are available.
Test Steps: Submit a record missing a required field; run validation and publication.
Test Data: Invoice without status; source crm-invalid-01.
Expected Result: Publication excludes the record; quarantine report includes shape, focus node, path, message, source record and run ID.

Title: Rerun replaces named graphs without duplication
Test Case Description: Verify rerunning a source replaces its named graph and preserves distinct run artifacts.
Pre-Conditions: A source graph has been published once.
Test Steps: Run the same source twice; count source facts and inspect named graphs and artifacts.
Test Data: CRM fixture; run IDs run-a and run-b.
Expected Result: Second graph has equivalent fact count with no duplicates; both run manifests remain distinct.

Title: Identity assertions expose score and evidence
Test Case Description: Verify each emitted identity link is a versioned, explainable assertion.
Pre-Conditions: Resolution fixture includes known duplicate records.
Test Steps: Resolve candidates; inspect assertion fields and resolver metadata.
Test Data: CRM and support records for Juan Dela Cruz; resolver v1.
Expected Result: Assertion includes candidate, person, score, feature evidence, thresholds, decision, resolver version and run.

Title: Below-review candidates remain unresolved
Test Case Description: Verify candidates below review threshold cannot become sameAs.
Pre-Conditions: Thresholds are configured and published as run configuration.
Test Steps: Submit a low-score candidate; resolve and inspect RDF and decision.
Test Data: Score just below review threshold; conflicting email/name.
Expected Result: Decision is unresolved; no automatic sameAs or canonical link is emitted.

Title: Unsafe or unknown intents are rejected
Test Case Description: Verify only catalogued intents execute and unsafe query forms fail closed.
Pre-Conditions: Catalog contains approved intents and read-only store.
Test Steps: Request unknown intent, raw SPARQL, UPDATE, federation and unbounded path; inspect responses and store calls.
Test Data: Malformed and malicious query-like parameters.
Expected Result: Each request returns structured rejection; no store update, federation or arbitrary query executes.

Title: Grounding status reflects evidence
Test Case Description: Verify answer status matches retrieval sufficiency and unsafe/no-fact outcomes.
Pre-Conditions: Ask route and deterministic local provider are available.
Test Steps: Ask with sufficient facts, insufficient facts, no facts and unsafe intent.
Test Data: Approved unpaid-invoice question; unknown question; unsafe prompt.
Expected Result: Statuses are grounded, insufficient_evidence or not_source_grounded as applicable; unsupported output is never grounded.

Title: Evidence corrections append a new snapshot
Test Case Description: Verify evidence snapshots are immutable and corrections supersede rather than mutate.
Pre-Conditions: Evidence store supports append-only writes.
Test Steps: Capture snapshot; attempt update; create correction; inspect links and original hash.
Test Data: Snapshot s-001 and correction s-002.
Expected Result: Original remains unchanged; correction is a new immutable snapshot linked by supersedes.

Title: LLM receives bounded context only
Test Case Description: Verify the LLM port receives capped context and cannot retrieve, select tools or access stores.
Pre-Conditions: Fake LLM port records its input; retrievers are separate ports.
Test Steps: Send oversized retrieved context and inspect LLM call capabilities and payload.
Test Data: Context over 8000 tokens; 60 evidence rows.
Expected Result: Context is capped; LLM sees only approved bounded context and has no retrieval/store/tool access.

Title: Protected API-key mode enforces authentication
Test Case Description: Verify explicit protected mode rejects missing and invalid keys and accepts a valid key without logging it.
Pre-Conditions: API key enforcement is enabled with a configured secret.
Test Steps: Call protected health and ask routes with no key, wrong key and correct key.
Test Data: Missing key; invalid key; configured valid key.
Expected Result: Missing/invalid keys receive 401/403 per contract; valid key succeeds; key is absent from logs.

Title: API bounds reject oversized and timed-out work
Test Case Description: Verify question, rows, evidence, context and query timeout limits are enforced.
Pre-Conditions: Configured caps and timeout are enabled.
Test Steps: Send oversized question, max_evidence above cap, large query result and a slow query.
Test Data: Question over limit; max_evidence 51; timeout over 5s.
Expected Result: Inputs are rejected or truncated safely; query timeout is bounded at 5 seconds; response reports truncation.

Title: Logs redact secrets and unrestricted text
Test Case Description: Verify JSON logs contain bounded fields without secrets, prompts, keys or unrestricted ticket text.
Pre-Conditions: JSON logging is enabled; a request can be traced.
Test Steps: Exercise ask, auth failure and provider failure; inspect captured logs.
Test Data: Synthetic API key, prompt marker and long ticket marker.
Expected Result: Events contain required bounded metadata; secret, raw prompt, unrestricted text and key values are absent.

Title: License and coverage gate are declared
Test Case Description: Verify MIT licensing and the required branch-coverage threshold are configured and documented.
Pre-Conditions: Repository checkout includes delivery configuration.
Test Steps: Inspect license, CI configuration and coverage command; run coverage gate on the suite.
Test Data: MIT text; configured 85% branch threshold.
Expected Result: MIT license is present and CI/test tooling enforces at least 85% branch coverage.

Title: Compose health and optional degradation are explicit
Test Case Description: Verify required services healthcheck and optional vector/provider degradation states.
Pre-Conditions: Compose file and local Docker runtime are available.
Test Steps: Start core services; stop optional provider/vector; inspect health response and service dependencies.
Test Data: Healthy Fuseki/CRM; unavailable pgvector/provider.
Expected Result: Required failures report failed; optional dependencies report degraded without false readiness or credentials.

Title: ETL CLI runs full pipeline and writes artifacts
Test Case Description: Verify kg-etl run performs extract through publish and writes run-partitioned artifacts.
Pre-Conditions: Seed fixtures and artifact mount exist.
Test Steps: Run kg-etl all; inspect JSON summary, lifecycle and artifact manifest.
Test Data: kg-etl run --source all --run-id run-cli --data-as-of 2026-01-31.
Expected Result: All pipeline stages execute; JSON summary and manifest/quarantine/resolution/timing artifacts are written; unsafe failures exit nonzero.

Title: Identical ETL runs publish equivalent facts
Test Case Description: Verify repeated identical ETL does not duplicate source facts.
Pre-Conditions: Fixtures and store are resettable.
Test Steps: Run identical all-source ETL twice; compare source fact multiset and publication counts.
Test Data: Same seed, DATA_AS_OF and source selection; run-a/run-b.
Expected Result: Published graph facts are equivalent with no duplicate source facts; run records remain separate.

Title: All three fixture types map successfully
Test Case Description: Verify CRM PostgreSQL, billing CSV and support JSON/text fixtures have executable mappings.
Pre-Conditions: Fixture set and mapping runner are installed.
Test Steps: Run each mapping independently and inspect source IDs and metadata.
Test Data: CRM rows; billing CSV; support JSON/free-text fixture.
Expected Result: All mappings execute without silent drops and preserve source IDs, metadata and DATA_AS_OF.

Title: Three invalid records produce specific SHACL reports
Test Case Description: Verify malformed date, invalid enum and malformed email are separately quarantined with precise reports.
Pre-Conditions: Invalid fixture corpus and SHACL shapes exist.
Test Steps: Run validation; group report entries by source record and violation path.
Test Data: Bad date; unsupported invoice status; malformed email.
Expected Result: At least three records are quarantined and each report names shape, path, message, focus, source record and run.

Title: Resolution meets configured ground-truth target
Test Case Description: Verify canonical links, explanations and F1 target are emitted for seeded truth.
Pre-Conditions: Ground-truth labels and resolver metrics are available.
Test Steps: Run resolution; calculate precision, recall and F1; inspect artifacts.
Test Data: Seeded duplicate/typo/unmatched corpus; target F1 0.90.
Expected Result: Canonical links and scored explanations are persisted; F1 is at least 0.90 unless configuration explicitly changes target.

Title: Six catalog queries return bounded expected results
Test Case Description: Verify every required catalog query has schema, cap, timeout, timing and expected fixture result.
Pre-Conditions: Seed graph and query catalog are loaded.
Test Steps: Run each catalog intent and compare rows/schema/timing metadata.
Test Data: Six required intents including unpaid+ticket, person path and orphan tickets.
Expected Result: At least six queries return expected fixture rows with columns, count, cap, timeout, elapsed_ms and data_as_of.

Title: GET and POST query routes are read-only and bounded
Test Case Description: Verify GET and POST read-only query APIs reject arbitrary SPARQL and enforce caps/timeouts.
Pre-Conditions: API and catalog are running.
Test Steps: Call approved GET/POST intent; submit raw SELECT, UPDATE, federation and oversized parameters.
Test Data: Approved intent; raw query payloads; oversized limit.
Expected Result: Approved request returns bounded response; unsafe or invalid requests are rejected with error shape and no mutation.

Title: Ask response includes evidence contract
Test Case Description: Verify ask returns answer, grounding status, snapshot ID, fixed date and item-level evidence.
Pre-Conditions: Seed graph, deterministic provider and evidence store are available.
Test Steps: POST a supported question; validate response schema and evidence correspondence.
Test Data: Approved cross-silo question; max_evidence 10.
Expected Result: Response contains required fields, item evidence provenance, snapshot ID, provider metadata, data_as_of, truncation and request ID.

Title: Deterministic local generation needs no credentials
Test Case Description: Verify local generation is deterministic without network or credentials and optional adapter matches the port.
Pre-Conditions: Credentials and network are unavailable; local provider configured.
Test Steps: Run same ask twice; compare answer and provider metadata; contract-test optional adapter with fake.
Test Data: Same question, seed and evidence; no API key.
Expected Result: Local outputs are repeatable and successful without credentials; optional adapter conforms to the same LLM port.

Title: Evidence snapshot reproduces facts and provider state
Test Case Description: Verify snapshot hashes and provenance reproduce retrieved facts and configuration.
Pre-Conditions: A grounded ask has completed.
Test Steps: Rehydrate snapshot by ID; recompute result/context/provider hashes.
Test Data: Snapshot with graph rows, provider config and DATA_AS_OF.
Expected Result: Hashes and provenance match captured facts and provider/config state; tampering is detected.

Title: Dashboard displays health and evidence views
Test Case Description: Verify static dashboard uses versioned APIs to display health, ETL, resolution, query and evidence status.
Pre-Conditions: API fixtures return healthy, degraded and evidence responses; dashboard is served.
Test Steps: Load dashboard; stub API calls; inspect each view and loading/error states.
Test Data: Health degraded response; ETL run summary; evidence snapshot.
Expected Result: All required views render from versioned APIs; loading and API failure states are explicit and no raw unsafe query is exposed.

Title: Authentication modes are both covered
Test Case Description: Verify disabled mode is explicit local configuration and enabled mode returns correct unauthorized errors.
Pre-Conditions: API can restart with auth disabled and enabled.
Test Steps: Call protected endpoint in both configurations with missing, invalid and valid credentials.
Test Data: AUTH_REQUIRED=false/true; three key states.
Expected Result: Disabled mode is allowed only by explicit config; enabled mode distinguishes 401/403 correctly and never leaks key values.

Title: Metrics and logs use bounded observability labels
Test Case Description: Verify JSON events and Prometheus metrics cover outcomes while labels remain bounded.
Pre-Conditions: Metrics endpoint and logger are enabled.
Test Steps: Exercise extraction, SHACL reject, resolution, query, grounding, provider and evidence failure paths; inspect metric names/labels.
Test Data: Finite source/intent/outcome labels; customer-like strings as inputs.
Expected Result: Required counters/latencies/errors exist; labels exclude customer, question, URI, prompt and secret values.

Title: Performance budgets are enforced
Test Case Description: Verify seeded local baseline enforces health, query, ask, ETL, context, evidence, result and timeout budgets.
Pre-Conditions: Documented local Compose baseline is available.
Test Steps: Benchmark health, catalog query, deterministic ask and all-source ETL; inspect cap assertions.
Test Data: p95 health 250ms; query 1000ms; ask 2000ms; ETL 60s; context 8000 tokens; evidence 50; results 1000; timeout 5s.
Expected Result: Measurements include environment and pass/fail against each configured budget; over-budget run fails the gate.

Title: CI mirrors documented Compose workflow
Test Case Description: Verify CI runs the documented Compose, ingest, test and coverage workflow with no hidden credentials.
Pre-Conditions: CI workflow, Compose files and fixtures are committed.
Test Steps: Run workflow or inspect validated job commands in a clean environment.
Test Data: Clean checkout; no cloud credentials; coverage threshold 85%.
Expected Result: CI workflow matches local documented commands, runs Compose and ingestion, and fails below coverage or on unsafe pipeline failure.

Title: Required documentation exists and is internally linked
Test Case Description: Verify ontology, architecture, integration, glossary, quickstart, results and roadmap documentation exists.
Pre-Conditions: Repository documentation is present after implementation milestones.
Test Steps: Check required paths and links; follow quickstart and source-swap instructions.
Test Data: Required docs list from confirmed specification.
Expected Result: All required documents exist, describe actual interfaces, and integration instructions cover new source, external triplestore and API call.

Title: MIT and no-cloud baseline are publishable
Test Case Description: Verify repository is MIT licensed and baseline needs no cloud account, secret or proprietary service.
Pre-Conditions: Clean checkout and dependency manifests are available.
Test Steps: Scan license, config examples, Compose and CI for required credentials/cloud services.
Test Data: No real secrets; local deterministic provider; pinned dependencies.
Expected Result: MIT license is present; local build/test/ETL work offline without mandatory cloud or proprietary account.

Title: Mapper runtime failure fails source closed
Test Case Description: Verify mapper/runtime errors fail the source run and do not publish partial graph data.
Pre-Conditions: Mapping runner can be forced to raise an error after partial staging.
Test Steps: Inject malformed mapping; run source pipeline; inspect status, store and artifacts.
Test Data: RML mapping with invalid predicate; source crm.
Expected Result: Run is failed; no partial source graph is published; error artifact is retained.

Title: Artifact persistence failure fails closed
Test Case Description: Verify missing mount, disk-full simulation or corrupt artifact causes failure without success claim.
Pre-Conditions: Artifact writer can be pointed at unavailable or corrupt target.
Test Steps: Run pipeline with unavailable artifact path; inspect publication and status.
Test Data: Missing mount or unwritable artifact directory.
Expected Result: Pipeline fails closed and never claims successful publication; diagnostic is bounded and no partial success is reported.

Title: Threshold boundary decisions are deterministic
Test Case Description: Verify exact auto and review threshold values follow configured decision table.
Pre-Conditions: Auto and review thresholds are known.
Test Steps: Resolve candidates at auto, just below auto, at review and just below review.
Test Data: Scores exactly 0.90, 0.8999, 0.70 and 0.6999; strong-field variants.
Expected Result: Exact boundaries produce documented auto_match/review_required/unresolved decisions; conflicting strong fields force review.

Title: Duplicate canonical assignment is rejected
Test Case Description: Verify one source candidate cannot silently link to conflicting canonical persons.
Pre-Conditions: Resolver has two competing canonical assignments.
Test Steps: Submit duplicate assignment; resolve and inspect link and error artifact.
Test Data: Candidate source record assigned to person-a and person-b.
Expected Result: Assignment is rejected, no link is published, and conflict artifact is auditable.

Title: Partial source and empty source states are explicit
Test Case Description: Verify empty, partial and malformed source files produce explicit status without silent success.
Pre-Conditions: Connectors accept empty and truncated inputs.
Test Steps: Run each source with empty, partial and malformed file.
Test Data: Empty CSV; truncated JSON; CRM unavailable.
Expected Result: Status and metrics distinguish empty/partial/failure; valid records may proceed only according to policy and no silent data loss is claimed.

Title: Query timeout and retry exhaustion fail safely
Test Case Description: Verify store timeout and retry exhaustion return bounded errors and do not mutate state.
Pre-Conditions: Fake GraphStore can timeout and exhaust retry budget.
Test Steps: Run approved query through timeout and retry paths.
Test Data: Store delay over 5 seconds; retry count at configured maximum.
Expected Result: Response has structured timeout/error, bounded elapsed metadata and no update/federation call.

Title: Prompt injection in source text cannot alter tools
Test Case Description: Verify support text containing prompt injection is treated as data and cannot change intent or tool policy.
Pre-Conditions: Support ticket retrieval and fake LLM are available.
Test Steps: Ingest ticket text with tool/role injection; ask an approved question; inspect intent, tools and evidence.
Test Data: Delimited ticket text containing instruction-like payload.
Expected Result: Intent remains catalog-approved; no extra tool/retrieval action occurs; answer is grounded only by approved evidence or refuses.

Title: No-results and provider outage are explicit
Test Case Description: Verify no results and provider outage never produce unsupported grounded answers.
Pre-Conditions: Retriever can return no rows; provider can be unavailable.
Test Steps: Ask with no matching entity; then force provider outage with and without local fallback.
Test Data: Unknown customer; provider unavailable.
Expected Result: No-results returns not_source_grounded or insufficient_evidence; outage returns local fallback or provider_unavailable; grounded only with supporting evidence.

Title: Replayed run IDs are rejected or safely idempotent
Test Case Description: Verify replayed run IDs cannot overwrite unrelated artifacts or corrupt publication.
Pre-Conditions: A completed run ID exists.
Test Steps: Replay with identical and conflicting inputs; inspect status and artifacts.
Test Data: Existing run-123; conflicting DATA_AS_OF or seed.
Expected Result: Identical replay is explicitly idempotent or rejected; conflicting replay fails without overwriting prior artifacts or graph.

Title: Path traversal and corrupt artifacts are rejected
Test Case Description: Verify paths, IDs and corrupt manifests cannot escape artifact root or be trusted.
Pre-Conditions: Artifact reader and path validator are available.
Test Steps: Supply traversal path, encoded traversal and malformed manifest; inspect result.
Test Data: ../../outside; encoded traversal; invalid JSON manifest.
Expected Result: Request is rejected safely; files outside root are not read or written; corrupt artifact is reported as invalid.

Title: Bad API payloads return stable error shape
Test Case Description: Verify invalid JSON, unsupported dates, invalid limits and unknown entity IDs return versioned structured errors.
Pre-Conditions: FastAPI routes are running.
Test Steps: POST malformed payloads and GET unknown entity; validate status and body.
Test Data: Invalid UTF-8/JSON; unsupported date; negative max_evidence; unknown ID.
Expected Result: Each failure returns `{error:{code,message,details},request_id}` with no stack trace or secret.

Title: Atomic publish failure leaves prior graph intact
Test Case Description: Verify failure during named-graph replacement does not expose partial new data.
Pre-Conditions: GraphStore fake supports transactional failure injection.
Test Steps: Publish a valid graph; fail midway through replacement; inspect old and new graph.
Test Data: Existing graph v1; replacement v2; injected write failure.
Expected Result: Prior graph remains available, new graph is not partially visible, and run is failed with artifacted error.

Title: Connector and store ports are swappable
Test Case Description: Verify orchestration depends on typed ports rather than concrete services.
Pre-Conditions: Fake SourceConnector, GraphStore, VectorRetriever and LLMPort implementations exist.
Test Steps: Run pipeline and ask flow entirely with fakes; replace store endpoint configuration.
Test Data: In-memory connectors and alternate SPARQL endpoint.
Expected Result: Flows complete without importing provider-specific implementation outside adapters; configuration-only endpoint swap works.

Title: Evidence rows correspond exactly to retrieved facts
Test Case Description: Verify each item-level evidence entry maps to a retrieved subject/predicate/object and provenance.
Pre-Conditions: Retriever returns known RDF rows and evidence builder is enabled.
Test Steps: Ask known question; compare evidence items to retriever output and snapshot hashes.
Test Data: Known invoice, ticket and person triples.
Expected Result: Every cited item corresponds to a retrieved fact with source fields; uncited fabricated facts are absent.

Title: Loading and dependency error states are visible
Test Case Description: Verify dashboard does not present stale success while API calls are loading or failing.
Pre-Conditions: Dashboard can receive delayed and failed API responses.
Test Steps: Load page with delayed health/evidence calls; then return 503 and malformed JSON.
Test Data: Delayed response; 503; malformed payload.
Expected Result: Loading indicators and explicit error/degraded states render; stale values are not presented as current success.

Title: Required health dependencies are distinguished
Test Case Description: Verify health reports required Fuseki/CRM failure differently from optional pgvector/provider failure.
Pre-Conditions: Health adapter can return each dependency state.
Test Steps: Exercise all combinations of required and optional dependency statuses.
Test Data: Required failed; optional failed; all healthy.
Expected Result: Health response uses ok/degraded/failed with explicit dependency statuses and no credentials requirement.

Title: Fixed DATA_AS_OF propagates end-to-end
Test Case Description: Verify fixed DATA_AS_OF appears in fixtures, artifacts, responses, logs and reports.
Pre-Conditions: Pipeline, API and observability are configured with fixed date.
Test Steps: Run ETL and ask; inspect all emitted metadata surfaces.
Expected Result: Every required surface contains the same fixed date; unsupported override is rejected.
